description: Source code for the 'Production Plan' doctype in ERPNext, including class definition, methods for validation, item management, work order creation, and material request handling.

classes.name: ProductionPlan
classes.description: Main class representing a production plan, with methods for validation, item management, work order creation, and status updates.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the production plan, calculating total planned quantity and setting status.

methods.name: validate_data
methods.description: Validates BOM and planned quantity for each item in the production plan.

methods.name: get_open_sales_orders
methods.description: Retrieves open sales orders pending delivery based on criteria.

methods.name: add_so_in_table
methods.description: Adds sales order data into the production plan table.

methods.name: get_pending_material_requests
methods.description: Fetches pending material requests based on criteria.

methods.name: add_mr_in_table
methods.description: Adds material request data into the production plan table.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Fetches items for the production plan from sales orders or material requests.

methods.name: get_so_mr_list
methods.description: Returns list of sales orders or material requests from specified table.

methods.name: get_bom_item
methods.description: Checks if an item or its template has an active BOM.

methods.name: get_so_items
methods.description: Retrieves sales order items pending for production.

methods.name: get_mr_items
methods.description: Retrieves material request items pending for production.

methods.name: add_items
methods.description: Adds items to the production plan, consolidating by BOM if needed.

methods.name: add_pp_ref
methods.description: Adds references between production plan items and sales orders.

methods.name: calculate_total_planned_qty
methods.description: Calculates total planned quantity across all items.

methods.name: calculate_total_produced_qty
methods.description: Calculates total produced quantity across all items.

methods.name: update_produced_qty
methods.description: Updates the produced quantity for a specific production plan item.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles cancellation of the production plan, deleting draft work orders.

methods.name: delete_draft_work_order
methods.description: Deletes draft work orders linked to the production plan.

methods.name: set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of the production plan based on current data.

methods.name: update_ordered_status
methods.description: Updates the status based on whether all planned quantities are ordered.

methods.name: update_requested_status
methods.description: Updates status if all material requests are fulfilled.

methods.name: get_production_items
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of production items with details for work order creation.

methods.name: make_work_order
methods.description: Creates work orders and purchase orders based on production plan.

methods.name: make_work_order_for_finished_goods
methods.description: Creates work orders for finished goods.

methods.name: make_work_order_for_subassembly_items
methods.description: Creates work orders for sub-assembly items.

methods.name: make_subcontracted_purchase_order
methods.description: Creates purchase orders for subcontracted items.

methods.name: show_list_created_message
methods.description: Displays message listing created documents.

methods.name: prepare_args_for_sub_assembly_items
methods.description: Prepares arguments for creating sub-assembly work orders.

methods.name: create_work_order
methods.description: Creates a work order document for a production item.

methods.name: make_material_request
methods.description: Creates grouped material requests based on production plan items.

methods.name: get_sub_assembly_items
methods.description: Fetches sub-assembly items based on BOM and manufacturing type.

methods.name: set_sub_assembly_items_based_on_level
methods.description: Sets sub-assembly items with level and manufacturing type.

methods.name: check_have_work_orders_completed
methods.description: Checks if all linked work orders are completed.
